name: module-packages-leave-out-skipped-directories
description: The packages of a module are its own directories outside the directories the Go program leaves out. A Go file below a node_modules directory, at the module root or deeper, one the module's own code imports among them, whose calls back into the module count, below a directory whose name starts with a full stop or an underscore, or below a testdata directory, is in no package of the module, so nothing in it is reported, while a dead function of the module's own package is.
